name: 33973 · Lehigh Acres, FL
findings: ZIP 33973 (Lehigh Acres) has 6 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
